independence: Reviewer authored the prior isolated orientation study, but did not author this production integration or its release fixture. This is an independent integration review; independent visual acceptance of the original seven-case study is separately recorded by root.
scope: Moss mineable north-edge upright orientation only. Actual production B dispatch, full original held-pose images, endpoint inspection, restoration and exact signed effect parity with the previously accepted held study.

findings: B places the authored top caps above the shaded faces on the central north band, reproducing the approved upright perspective while retaining the material and stone scale.

Both endpoint regions were inspected in the full originals. The existing full-corner shoulders, rotated side-leg perspective and stepped overlaps remain visible; this integration does not resolve them.
No additional visible defect attributable to production integration was found in this held pose. A2 visibly restores A and the full-frame decoded and file-byte comparisons are exact.

pixel_proof.method: Independently decoded full RGBA PNGs with Pillow; signed B minus A arrays computed with NumPy int16, then compared at every channel of every pixel. No crops or unsigned subtraction.

code_review.guard: Only diggable cells, side 0, non-null texture with the exact Moss edge resource path use the new draw path. Other sides, permanent bedrock and other biome textures keep their prior owner.
code_review.mapping: Same eight 128 by 128 source segments, posmod(-cell.x + depth_at_position(center) % 11, segment_count), full 64 by 64 world quad and X reflection; only the Y orientation becomes upright. No asset changes, clipping or scaling adjustment.
code_review.transform_lifecycle: The local draw transform resets to identity immediately after the one draw call.
code_review.fixture: B invokes actual production super._draw_permanent_wall_face. A/A2 replay the old mineable/bedrock owner. Section caches are invalidated for each phase; the report records 336 redrawn sections per phase, and 40 eligible B draw calls.
code_review.state_contract: Capture report retains the same camera, limits, zoom, culling rectangle and geometry fingerprint through A/B/A2. Seed 4608, Deep 14/window 13; held player is on walkable floor with no terrain mutation.
code_review.protected_scope: Moss edge and corner assets, shared edge drawer, lighting owner, shader and project source hashes match the capture report; the commit makes no change to those files.

limits: This frozen source-project held pose uses a valid-floor fixture teleport; it is not continuous player traversal or performance evidence. The separate accepted seven-case study covers affected gameplay states.

Cross-run full-frame identity is false: each matching phase differs from the historical capture at 35,448 RGBA pixels. Only the signed A-to-B effect is identical at every pixel; the cause of all between-run state differences was not independently diagnosed here.
Existing corners, short steps, pillars and biome seams remain unresolved. No broad world-quality, native-motion, all-tool, physical-iPhone or FPS acceptance is implied.
Normal exact-package release checks remain required. This review did not run a renderer, alter production source, or certify the published package.

source_gate_context.basis: Parent report only; not rerun or independently certified by this visual/code review.

Isolated unchanged DEV11 control and candidate reruns passed; original failure was retained. No runtime workaround or output filter was introduced.
